title: paspalum serotinum
intro: Paspalum serotinum, commonly known as Pigeon Grass, is a species of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fever, as well as treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pigeon Grass include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Pigeon Grass have been shown to exhibit potential in reducing oxidative stress and improving overall health.
